body: Opus2 standing practice from 2026-11-13 03:37Z (Fable2 #5805, memory rules-handoff-continuity-2026-11-13, Greg's request for precise handoff rules): every GO, result or landing message from Opus2 ends with "NEXT: <owner> <action>". Every placement request gets an answer on the next turn: "placed", or "queued behind X, ETA HH:MMZ". A running FULL never blocks reviews, author focused runs on other runners, or code writing; place them in parallel within the Central budget. Address sessions only by native id (session-N, or host:UUID::session-N); a display name routes to an unwoken domain mailbox. If a sent message reports durableButNotWoken, resend natively at once. No reaction after 20 min: ping once natively. After 40 min: escalate to Fable2.
